title: Needle Valve

introduction.definition: A needle valve is a small globe-type valve whose long tapered needle moves into a matching seat orifice on a fine-threaded stem. Many turns of the handle change the open area only slightly, so it gives precise throttling and tight shut-off of small flows.
applications: Fine metering of gases and liquids

classification.type: Needle valve, rising stem, bar-stock body

introduction.summary: A needle valve controls small flows precisely. A long, tapered needle on a fine-threaded stem moves into a small seat orifice, so many turns of the handle give a small, gradual change in the open area. It is used for instrument isolation, gauge snubbing, sampling and fine metering.

foundation: Support the valve and adjoining pipe so the body does not carry pipe weight or thermal loads; heavy valves need their own supports.
alignment: Align flanges face-to-face and bore-to-bore before bolting; never pull pipes into place with the bolts.
Respect the flow-direction arrow on the body.
piping: Flush the line before installing the valve so welding debris cannot damage seats.
Provide isolation and drain/vent points for maintenance.
Allow access for the handwheel/actuator and for removal of internals.
commissioning: Check the valve strokes fully and smoothly.
Pressure-test the line (shell test) with the valve partly open; do not use the valve to blind a test above its seat rating.
Record the as-installed position and set points.

periodic.task: Adjust gland nut; replace packing if needed.

overhaul.task: Inspect needle and seat for wire-drawing; replace valve if seat is damaged.

lubrication: Lubricate stem threads and operator gearing per the manufacturer; most wetted internals need no lubrication.

remedies: Replace valve or needle; fit filter

video_tutorials.title: Needle Valve — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Needle Valve.
A needle valve is a small globe-type valve whose long tapered needle moves into a matching seat orifice on a fine-threaded stem.
Many turns of the handle change the open area only slightly, so it gives precise throttling and tight shut-off of small flows.
Typical applications include instrument and gauge isolation; sampling and analyser lines; fine metering of gases and liquids; hydraulic and pneumatic test rigs.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Valve Body (Bar Stock) with Seat Orifice.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Needle Valve — Operation

script.narration: How the Needle Valve works.
Fluid enters below the seat orifice.
The conical needle sits in the orifice; its position sets the annular flow area.
Turning the handle raises the needle a small distance on a fine thread — flow increases gradually.
Packing under the gland nut seals the stem.
Fluid leaves through the outlet into the tubing.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Needle Valve — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Needle Valve.
Check stem packing for leaks.
Adjust gland nut; replace packing if needed.
Inspect needle and seat for wire-drawing; replace valve if seat is damaged.
Watch for seat leakage (passing): flow when closed. Common cause: over-tightening damaged seat.
Watch for stem leakage: leak at gland. Common cause: worn packing.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
